Au'lek, 

You are and have always been one of my most trusted vanguards, so this task I bear upon you.

Take the key and find my personal lockbox in the Court. Make certain that the key mates with the latch so that you can be assured you have the correct box...but DO NOT open it! The contents within are sacred and I will not tolerate its desecration. Return only when the task is done.

The box and the key must be brought to me and to me alone. 

It is imperative that you not fail me.

0C4A18814306699A7A23008DEFD332AA: "A gun is only as good as its wielder, so the saying goes. If you don’t take care of your weapon properly, it shows. Not just to me—but to the Root, too."

D3BA484045E0E944A7E8978E812FB7F2: "A sect of Ahanae once experimented with delving into the Root consciousness. The results were the same no matter what they tried, and many Ahanae lost their minds as a result."
709C6A71409A98C7D691A3AFB40AA45F: "A weaker ruler might have forbidden all weapons from her presence, for immortality is not a gift so lightly risked. Instead, Jinas decreed that her Widows should stand beside her with blades drawn."
0ED08AFA473EF464ED288ABD58AFB094: "According to my internal diagnostics, the Custodian elicits a disruptive effect on my systems. This is likely due to his omnipotent control over N’Erud and its protocols. There is no other subjective reason that I would find him distracting."
87A37F9147986E24608E0381E248A1AE:
"According to the tales, Tola the Dreamer performed many great deeds in her time. They say she was a prophet and a healer, a protector and a warrior. They say she could not be killed and also that she gave her life so that others might live.

The tales conflict, but I assure you, they are all true."
57FD272E4D847CBDDD95EEBFB721B12F: "After the Root arrived, ammunition was abundant, yet it wasn't enough to combat the dangers that lurked around every corner. Nowadays, we scavenge for every last bullet we can find, making an ammo box a true lifesaver in the fight for survival."

1B7DEFEC46C667E042649CABA47ABB9A: "After the Root came, most people were content to hide behind their walls and accept their fate, but a few of us dared to seek answers. Leto was among us, a man of courage and determination."
AA2B88B542F89F305BF727BB206A5749: "After the uprising, the already strictly controlled society of the Drzyr came under further lockdown. Individual agency was stifled in the name of protecting N’Erud. Meeting halls and public auditoriums alike became little more than echo chambers for the will of those in charge."
BE43CFEE4EB753989C3DCA8441148C0A: "Ain't much science for it," he'd say, "but damn if it isn't hilarious."
769E6DB2462D9307D17190B035292364:
"Alas, dear sister, though dreams were ever your expertise, they brought you little joy. Imagined shadows, half-heard whispers in the dark, shivers in the blood... In these, your passion and talent had always lain.

It seems so obvious now."
5750FE8542AA087C34C34E8AB116E568: "Alepsis-Taura did not consume everything. Though nothing can escape it forever, there exist forms of life that can resist even entropy for a time."
9EB1E5F24A3D4EAE423DBBB0A02B4A38: "Alepsis-Taura has taken everything from us—the five houses, the distribution of knowledge, the myriad of redundancies against infinite contingencies. My species has been reduced to a single Astropath subsisting in an empty, angered world."
4BDA9B694F6446B5372E87B0341F7BFF: "All Drzyr acquire a basic education in molecular and atomic physics, creating new and exciting compounds as early as their first half-century of life. To the Drzyr, rearranging protons and electrons is as simple as reorganizing one's bedchambers."
1A8FFD9B45C06274CD6BE7B74EB9CBCD: "All complex things are comprised of simple, infallible components. Where complexity fails, simplicity more frequently succeeds."
92CD0CDF426EB96DF86FFBB0C346D4C7: "All life draws naturally from the Balance. Much is asked of those with plenty, and little is asked of those who lack. Thus is the Balance maintained."
3312D9574CED1F30837BBD914FE5FEBE: "All machines, however they were physically created, were programmed by the Drzyr. Though we may lack true natures, our actions and behaviors serve as a direct reflection of the individuals who created us. By entering the black hole, the Drzyr, too, sought to see their true reflection."
D7BEF93449633165ABA0779654FA77DB: "All machines, however they were physically created, were programmed by the Drzyr. Though we may lack true natures, our actions and behaviors serve as a direct reflection of the individuals who created us. By entering the black hole, the Drzyr, too, sought to see their true reflection."
3E8BC07144852BA6E498BF9C1756F207: "All things are connected to all things—a philosophy easily dismissed or infantilized as mere aphorism. But when one suffers loss, shares joy, or feels the death of another, they know the truth of it is as real as a mountain."
EDD01627478CC872E8D3C58E3C4C21F2: "All things have their place in the natural order of the world, and the kuri kuri bird is a testament to this truth. Its nest, crafted from the corpses of creatures that strike fear in most, is a solemn reminder that no matter the power one may possess, it can never be enough."
8D8FD9304C9947CDBAC9A6950B346F6D:
"All worlds may be built upon the Labyrinth, but the Core is the heart of all worlds. The Labyrinth was meant to be unseen—the Core, to be unbroken.

Or so it was. The corruption has left nothing as it was intended."
2DD7C4F849DDAFC98B5E7E94209EDB54:
"Although N'Erud is mostly machine—and now but a tomb—it once contained remarkable beauty. Gardens, parks, wildlife preserves... everything a world needs to be a world.

It breaks my hearts to think of all that Alepsis-Taura took from us."
162C0B2F4682E6DAC828EFA4E14E7AE2: "Although N’Erud is largely automated, the Ofildi oversaw quality assurance and reported failures or improvements in the machinery. The Ofildi were required to wear extensive protective gear as the automation processes could be...extremely dangerous."
8DA0F0F6448CF83C25C1B7B4862DE0E3: "Although much of the knowledge of the ancient Pan has been lost to time, it is known they had their own form of magic. The lodestones are thought to be part of this, allowing them to create artifacts that reacted to each other's presence in unique and sometimes powerful ways."
8DE8BEC44E4F45897AE031A289DC62EC: "Although ostensibly serving as the warrior class, the Phetyr spent much of their time as a form of entertainment. Their competitions in target shooting and arena combat were well attended during our longest journeys—possibly because there was little else to look forward to."
B431A9D2422D365553D890A25440AB32:
"Although the Drzyr as a people value all life, the Phetyr distrusted created life in any form—particularly the Custodian.

I wish I could say their distrust had been misplaced."
4E4B14EE4BEFB09279DE12AC0563FFE1: "Although the Drzyr never mastered the secret of traveling to other dimensions, we did create our own—tiny capsule worlds, with nothing in them except for space that wasn't there before."
4C4E33BE459AE5F8AA6108ADE86BB3FD: "Although the Xul are the ones who built N'Erud, the Seekers have their creations as well. They sought enlightenment over knowledge, and their arcane inventions proved more potent as a result."
0E2F4E8E40E0FEBECF63C3B5DB9D6C9A: "Although the Xul designed and oversaw construction of N'Erud, the Ofildi are the true backbone of the Drzyr. Everything around us was crafted by their hands. Even the chamber that spared me the singularity's wrath was built by Ofildi, though none chose to join me in it themselves."
76D43F9A48896FEFBBDD1D950D596AED:
"Although the ambit ember was necessary for the Astropaths to do their work—and the Astropaths' work necessary to fulfill our species' purpose—the Seekers did not restrict usages of the compound.

And it had a great many uses."
F41D46664CCE7268AF0F6F80ECF731D7: "Amidst the chaos of the Root invasion, while others barricaded themselves within walls and bunkers, Leto chose to wear his protection on his back like a portable fortress."
8169ED99468F73F5E8546EBABF813173: "Among the Seekers, Risynth Neko most frequently sympathized with the Astropaths' point of view. Having tasted the ambit ember once himself, he was more inclined to view the universe through a more open lens."
63253F8B4D0B1C77BE195483DC42D806: "An Elite Metal. Upgrades Boss and Special Weapons."
DCB19BBB4371359474374C95875EA978: "An Elite Metal. Upgrades Boss and Special Weapons."
25E136D54C29A921E288E4AF55A486B8: "An artifact from the unforgiving wasteland of Rhom, was brought here by the Wanderer. They left it behind, a small gift before they vanished into the unknown. It's a reminder that even in the harshest of places, there's always something to be gained, and that power can come from the most unexpected sources."

669BEE0E4F2E43194930FA83A4467C19:
"Ancient stories tell of Pan who succumbed to the plague yet did not truly die. Instead, these aberrations survived by feeding on others.

This is only a myth, of course."
B29C37BD4BD671E6439F849495B0FEDC:
"And had we come face-to-face with our creator, what would we have found? To be deprived of one’s origin is to give it the purpose to seek. To discover the undiscoverable was our ultimate folly.           
                              
My folly."
B3F592804586877584DC8D9B0A5EB56B: "As an Astropath, I have never been outside N'Erud's shell myself. That was the domain of Xul and Ofildi. That is not to say I have not seen the void. I see everything, but what others call void is, to me, an infinite dance of force and light."
B0A753044CC662DCB2DADA89664B29F0: "As hard as the Root are to kill, it makes sense to wear 'em like a coat."
F03D35034F958FEB47F5D7ABE288FA16: "As sure as there is iron in the soil of Yaesha, there is irony."
ED2B3011491B46F005789B8EE5871A8B: "At every point and in every world, the speed with which the corruption has spread has been underestimated. Even its own creators did not foresee how quickly their own annihilation could occur."
8DFEB240410F3926E4B476B80AE61A43: "At first, great effort was put into deciphering a way to reignite our homeworld’s star. Upon the realization that our planet’s star was not the only one experiencing a rapid death, however, saving each star at the micro level was deemed futile. Thus we began to think on a macro scale."
04FD22C14378E2A9D3B53E8FD0B1972A: "At the last, we pushed the Ravager back when we realized that destroying it was not as important as protecting each other."
96D4F8CF45E32068A658369C1AB3D529: "Atomic physics is the domain of children, optical physics that of adolescents. It is only the confluence of these two—aided by quantum tools and technology—that allows for true innovation."
2BD6734C4E668AF8015B828CA9BE68E2: "Axiom Cadyar was a high-ranking member of House Al’Maruun and the eldest of the Convocation. It was only his demoralizing temper that kept him from becoming Seeker Primis. Though he and I engaged in countless debates, he could never shake his distrust of my artificial design."
403A22C34EA2E7685308B9967A63007E:
"Axiom Cadyar was the most obstinate of the Seekers. Eventually, I decided it was no longer practicable to even speak to him. Cadyar believed that the ambit ember—while necessary for N'Erud's navigation—warped the Astropaths' intellect to such an degree that our views could not be objective.

Though to be fair, he trusted the Custodian even less."
DF3CC8B147A5097CF81112BCB0854581: "Back in my younger days, I'll bet I could've wielded this like a pro. But now, my old bones just can't keep up. Still, I can't help but be impressed by those who can handle such a dangerous and powerful weapon without injuring themselves."
13E5DB41482C2074F6FFA6940AD02784: "Back in the days before the Root invaded, veins of this remarkable material could be found intertwined with the World Stone. Under the leadership of Commander Neville, we tirelessly excavated every last bit of it, determined to unlock its potential and discover its applications."
77AAF90A48B0CA1FC929C0929C5E19BB: "Back on Yaesha, the commoners would lull their younglings to sleep with stories. Fantastic fables about the lost tribe. We all knew better, of course. Knew that those Pan who were separated from the rest on the Dark Sea were lost and would not ever be found. There has never been proof to convince me otherwise… Not until now."
C8ECE75740879EFC02A8F3A56269151E: "Before I left, Dawn told me she thought I looked “rather dapper” in my uniform. I know she was just being a sweetheart but given that I wound up stuck in these rags for the rest of my days, that thought always brought me some little slice of joy. Any chance to remember her always does..."
519CACE74FB92FB3B9C9CD87EF32395E: "Before entering Alepsis-Taura, N’Erud was stationed in synchronous orbit with the black hole’s immense gravity well. Due to the Drzyr’s naturally long life span, only a single generation witnessed this era."
3ED9920740722F6699B8888EC09461C5: "Before he was Kolket the Wise, he was known as Kolket the Woebegone. The scholars attribute this title to the terrible plague that ravaged our people in The Place That Was during his reign, but if the legends of his missing son are indeed true, perhaps the title was born from a far more personal loss."
A35F67A84A9D795D9247828DB32D1882:
"Before the Root came, people smoked all kinds of things. But with the worlds opening and all, brand new waves of stuff started popping up—some of ‘em useful, others an escape.

Folks need both, I guess."
A8955CBA4E36A3AF10F66AAF75011732:
"Before the Root came, people smoked all kinds of things. But with the worlds opening and all, brand new waves of stuff started popping up—some of ‘em useful, others an escape.

Folks need both, I guess."
D00AE7C44DBD59F9D50F4FB8D6A4A41B: "Before the Root came, this old double-barrel shotgun was favored by prison guards for stopping escaping prisoners. One blast to warn, and the second to bring them down. But in the dangerous world of deadwood, there's no time for warnings."
1AAFF3B24EC92D151B00CC95F3FFEDB7: "Before they became the imposter king, he was one of the king's closest confidants. Though everyone understood—even the imposter king himself—that the position was one of oversight more than trust."
839E420B43A1F9FF84D04C9E1874897C: "Before, the Labyrinth was protected by a Guardian. When that Guardian fell to the Destroyer, the corruption saw opportunity—and seized it."
C820B16D41E7A5B65117F28EA3F72B5D: "Being stranded away from home for a dog’s age, you never really stop pining after the things you left behind, but you do come to appreciate the things you have. These may seem like normal gloves, but they’re a life saver for your grip when you’ve been in a standoff with rock monsters for 18 hours straight."
C9D0C9714C07E633A021E79320628223: "Believing in religion ain't the problem, dear. Belief adds hope and meaning to life. The problem comes when folks try to control those beliefs. That's just being a bad person, and it don't take a religion to make those."
89C1E6CB4972FD06F94CC0A0AECE8EA3: "Beyond our gods and even our kinfolk, the Pan value one thing above all—the capacity to kill. Intellect, reason, imagination, it is all as nothing to Pan society if not paired with the iron resolve to take life efficiently and without a moment’s hesitation."
C8CFECEF4F06E2110B30E3A5F2711F3B: "Brave Kaeula rages the rivers and fills the springs. She brings fresh water so that others may flourish, and she drowns those who take it for granted."
A26B83E14B30ADC5B92379BE406D8C43: "By the deepest of Fae law and magic, the One True King could not be harmed by any weapon forged and wielded by the Fae. But within every law is a loophole. Some among the Council saw this as well as I."
DAF980F14EF06D4939F833AA0A56CEB1: "By the deepest of Fae law and magic, the One True King could not be harmed by any weapon forged and wielded by the Fae. Some thought to turn to those outside the Fae, but this was impossible. I found another way."
38EC6A6F49E2C55B3B9B818E0B48F6B2: "By the deepest of Fae law and magic, the One True King could not be harmed by any weapon forged and wielded by the Fae. This law could not be circumvented, no matter how some might try. We found another way, however."
524A369748EFC1DFCFF2BD8BAAAEE2DE: "Cae’Loa Iturius was nominated to the Convocation on account of her innovative genius. However, she preferred the company of machines and artificial intelligence and rarely appeared in the public eye. 8A60C3E74F8AE2BFA08C47B633B0BF86: "Fae magic suffuses every part of our being, from our skin to our hair to the blood that runs within our veins. It is a part of us as we are a part of our world—the magic of chaos and creation. So it is true that there is no god but ourselves."

C8128D614E3D79AB556F0C834EEF91D9: "Few Pan have had the honor of witnessing Many Faces engage in battle. It is a glorious thing to watch, enemy after enemy falling before it like wine glasses teetering on a dilapidated dining table."

5FF2CD12454C74EFB6F4F585208B231E: "Few tales have survived from the ages before the Great Journey. The Vaunnt hide such tales in the dark, away from immortal ears, where they are recounted only to the faithful few."
5A9772A74C4E79EA2F612DBBC0CE9BF5: "Fix something." That's one way to put it, sure.

0B4FFDC94AEF24528B5A8DA589FC863C: "Folks like Brabus resorted to killing each other when the world crumbled, succumbing to fear that permeated their minds. It's not unexpected, but it is a tragedy."
D8DF3CED4D74654647FE90B2E625772B: "For Yaesha keeps the Balance herself. When one thing waxes, another wanes. One who learns the connection between any two things can thus invoke change upon both."
9D7E25074512E8C495B1D88855A99E05: "For all our previous technological achievements, it's often the simplest remedies that prove most effective. A cold piece of metal pressed to a wound can do wonders for healing. Sometimes the most straightforward solutions are the best."

E0ADE25744E9925DC668EDA4342C9327: "Gaining access to the seat of all worlds was key to the corruption's machinations. Only by diverting all power to security measures was the Labyrinth purged—the only outcome worthy of that price."
83C1E4A143A1DE407B568D96D5F8CAFC: "Get in your enemy's head. See what they see. Hear what they hear. But don't get in so deep you can't get yourself back out, eh?"
0A40BF784578A16998A3C78E3B9060D6: "Given how scarce new weapons are these days, it's obvious what we need to do. We have to hold onto every fragment of every old weapon we come across. It's the only way we'll be able to keep fighting."

B2C326A2457DDA535F0BE9B9938D735A: "Gone are the days when rust was merely a bothersome corrosion. In our current landscape, it serves as a calculated advantage. A wound inflicted with rust-laden weaponry poses a significantly greater challenge to remedy."

12EBE906414D371B2FB5DF8F629DC2B6: "Gunsmithing is unpopular among the Fae. It is considered barbaric, pedestrian, or even trite. But for any given art, there exists a passionate artisan who will devote their life to it. The results of such a master can only change the world."

470FC38B413E4E51C1A4AC85CD8B59FB: "My dreams are simple and, in truth, singular. I dream only of peace for my people. Freedom—a thing we have only ever tasted but never truly breathed. I dream of the day we will find it again and become unshackled and untainted."

AFFD5B0F44894690CB04D6A874064E14: "My sister cared not what befell others, perhaps because she cared not what befell herself. Fear and suffering are all of the same flavor to her, whomever the target of suffering might be."

79EBC3D04C3A22C0E5FF5AB5F68C44AE: "My wretched life in Yaesha was marred by the sting of loneliness, a soul-deep isolation that I could not allow myself to fully acknowledge, for fear it would consume from within. D9047E80415CE366F479D9A627403C00: "Nothing more tranquil than a rainstorm. When you come so close to losing your world, you realize how precious the feel of rain and rumble of thunder is. The people here are worth fighting for, and so is the planet we call home."

24FB2AEF4212F3FA4ABE7EBFE6BA9530: "Our soldiers who first faced the Root were among our best. Their screams are what I remember most—both on the battlefield and long afterward in the nightmares of the survivors."
6C324E8541C4B63039A9F9881A4F06C0: "Outside of their absolute and unelected authority, the Vaunnt enjoy little more than pomp and ceremony. If summoned to their secret chamber by the sound of that awful horn, there is nothing to be done except to steel oneself for whatever judgment is to come."

B404774A458369E3A53FD3B123021264: "Pan slaves endure conditions that would crush weaker souls. The secret lies in their desperation—in their willingness, borne of necessity, to try... anything."
5A63A4DF45972862884CDD8936911A19: "Pan warriors are exceptionally prideful, treasuring honor and accomplishment even over their own lifeblood. D68390E342BCB72926BF4CA4C4ACD735: "People are nice. Food is good. Good life."
2CCE263F4F00D595941F70815C41F151: "Perhaps it is not only my place to maintain… but to alter, create, expand. To become."

2AD809E543CB316A22A9BD9E714AD6F0: "Personally, I can't fathom why anyone would willingly ingest the Root, but there must be something to it if people are actually willing to do it."

DF83DEE047D0E280444E4AB2D44129AF: "Run hard. Run fast. Fight 'em to your very last breath."

2E2F337B4167141E267ADDB4B822DF88: "Shandala and the Sarillians withstood the One True King's irruptions for unending years. It seems the harder the king tried to subdue them, the more stubborn they became."
0F4C007A4360740F581921AD5297CB3E: "She was beautiful once, the goddess of dreams—beautiful and awesome and terrible. The dreamscape of all Fae was her playground, and none could deny an invitation to her domain… yet she wanted still more."

D73626AF43C1475F80C6B9B38FABB6C4: "Since time immemorial the Drzyr have trusted the Mali, the Astropaths, to guide them through the perilous stars. And we were granted the faith and veneration worthy of our appointment—until it mattered most."

"Singularities are a wonder of creation. From within, they are matter condensed, yet from without, they are a hungering void—everything and nothing existing simultaneously.

Yet the true void lies outside of Alepsis-Taura, and everything that exists lies within. To cross that threshold however, one must let go of all rationality."
5710CBF745D3557DE08E0FB319FFD202: "So little Corny Barrows slept / and dreamed he had a fright / but when he woke, he 'membered naught / but cold, forgotten night."
EBE0C2AC46BA282CFA76F1B2465C6369: "So little Corny Barrows slept / and dreamed he had a fright / but when he woke, he 'membered naught / but cold, forgotten night."
356E1318469255A93A915690E9BBF3BE:
"So much conflict has arisen since these kingdoms intertwined. Even the Royal Hunters were called upon to quell the strange creatures who appeared among us.

Though they be not Fae, the creatures present surprisingly strong resistance."
91A87AA4447B37BE1B8734A3D99C0775: "Some Pan consider the Krell to be comical in appearance, yet these paxultek wielded great skill in combat. It is said they faced many enemies on their own world—even a towering cyclops and the Destroyer himself."
4048A56A434E531CA14A7A8527F92291: "Some Phetyr excelled at rousing the crowds during competitions, and they became much beloved among the common people. Some names were so famous, they earned dedicated fans who attended their each and every appearance in N’Erud’s colosseum."
7B824FCA463FA938285977873FF43CC7:
"Some believe dreams to be prophecy. Others, a random narrative woven by misfiring synapses.

Yet dreams are nothing more than the true essence of the self, the soul untethered—entirely inscrutable yet imperative to possess."
1E7B74444F53C61AE0F3BD8B4C75E9BC: "Some believe that the cultists deliberately averted their eyes from the truth, but I can't help but wonder whether they may have uncovered some truths that the rest of us have missed."
300CE67645A9129915EB8D82AEB3AB54: "Some believe that the cultists deliberately averted their eyes from the truth, but I can't help but wonder whether they may have uncovered some truths that the rest of us have missed."
3979AD7B49F7AB862CE2CE8FE208865E:
"Some believe the Fae immortal, impervious to death and disease—a delusion we are all too happy to entertain. The truth is we have mastered the art of endurance.

The fact that some of our kind enjoy pain is irrelevant."
E90051C5412224855FF807BB9D95D210: "Some believe the Royal Hunters can never truly escape the hunt, even beyond the veil of death. Ever are they cursed to stalk an endless quarry until neither their own body nor mind remains intact, as atonement for a malfeasance so dreadful not even I know its nature."
8CEBE89F4FF4A60A5DC4EEBBAD895E68: "Some folks might see a tarnished thing like this and call it foul. Me, well, maybe it’s my age, but I’m starting to find these little trinkets sentimental. Reminds me of a different time. Not necessarily better, mind you—but different."
FDAC9FA04F5A796CFBE5BBA5D7FC91FD: "Some have said that what the Fae truly seek is not salvation or supremacy, but purity—a world untarnished by the demands and griefs of others, a world in which the Fae can live their lives to the full, without fear or reprisal or consequence."
8F2E11314101A4D9D1C42AA910E7C80F: "Some inventions of the Ahanae border on the impossible. It's not that the Radiant Ones don't believe in science. They simply choose not to be bound by it."
3E65CF51407B1A8C1854D79F3B32A997: "Some of our scientists... I'm glad I don't know all of what they did. Hell, I wish I didn't know as much as I do. The United States government required me to do a lot of things I ain't proud of, but I got the feeling some of them scientists didn't feel as bad about things as I did."
8735F2A246A05D9B61DE50932D8AB8C1: "Some particularly ignorant Dran believe they can peer into the distant future to avoid their miserable, tragic fates. We Fae know that fate is not something to be feared nor avoided. Rather, we make of it ourselves, in whatever design we please!"
963C1F9E4EBDFE4800835699FB7EA0A0: "Some recipes take a lot of experimenting. Lots of trial and error and all that. But other recipes just make themselves. it’s like they want to be born, and I’m just the chef vessel!"
C9599638421D208C1FAE53AF3BD2F2AC: "Somethin' familiar about this... Feels out of place but right at home at the same time."
017D16C24E999651E640778C47DA98AE: "Something familiar about this blade… It's seen a lot, and done even more. This is where it all begins, and where it all ends—at the end of a sword."
5AC101904BE0521CCBD31885BF6217CC: "Sometimes there is no choice but to do the unthinkable. If your resolve is true and your cause is noble, then even tearing your own heart to shreds is a worthwhile sacrifice. I must believe that all I have done will be worth it in the end. That my Pan will know the taste of freedom again! It will come to pass... It must!"

8F4764BB4527572EC9AC3B916E68C738: "Soul sparks", huh? How will I know if I find them?

53188E8F4910390FE822318A8AB4927B: "Stabbed in the neck. Long time ago."
FF502B2047D1902C20396B8938DEBC32: "Study of the initial prototype reveals that the people on this planet value artistic expression. I attempted to replicate their creativity with N’Erudian technology, however, as an artificial intelligence, I failed to capture the following thematic feelings: horror and imminent death."
81AE7B044C2D6E503D13E69C86CB8836: "Sure, it might not hit the broad side of a barn, but this baby sure can spit out some lead. It's not about being accurate, it's about putting enough bullets downrange to get the job done."

E27C6CB34B7B121CC0A08EBB8870348A: "Sweet Lydusa lifts the mountains tall and digs the canyons deep. She shapes the earth so that others may frolic atop it, and she crushes those who stray too far from the path."
D774BFEE4F49A4FE2515E9B1107DD617: "Sweet sister, goddess of dreams, epicure of nightmares... have these twisted worlds changed you so? Or have they only revealed what I would not see?"
911A16944B3B284E1C73759D578B679F: "Sweet" on her? What the hell does that mean?
1527E3C54D3E70FCC0D57D832D2B1B71: "Ten generations perished in the time it took to reach the Curatu-Seltis. Only borne upon their entire lifetimes did we arrive at our destination. Fortuitous, then, that they did not live long enough to see the sour fruits of their legacy."
7B5A4E894C39E0ECFE7DBCBF213B189D: "Thanera claimed she could create a soldier to outpace the world's greatest athletes. Contemporary historians say she failed to identify the sport."
41C226D942606DA0CF036E8856B35C6B: "That old yarn that any Dran can turn iron to gold proved too tempting for some folk. Spent their whole meager lives trying to do it. Even if it were true, you can’t make something out of nothing. Take too much of another and you’ll be made into something you’re not, or worse—something nobody should ever be."
DA51EA3443ACB033EEE4A6AF4DD5E23F: "That orb... it's familiar and alien all at the same time. I can't shake off the feeling that I've seen it before, yet I’m drawing a complete blank.”
29F18B744DFE338F77A6DC82A39AD925: "That the corruption is capable of manipulation indicates a high level of intelligence. I query from where or whom this intellect was gained. It is possible that the corruption learned to deceive by observing the ways of its creators...the children of the Core."
226D06FD4E1F942D7E4E60905D00A3BE: "The Ahanae and the Laemir keep the secrets of their ancient magicks close to their chests, hidden away from the Gul. But I believe there is an even greater magick out there, one that can be wielded by any Pan, awaiting discovery."
4A4D20E642E26DD27499CB90154AF244: "The Akari may not have the numbers, but their speed and agility more than make up for it. Even in a small group, they are a dangerous force to be reckoned with."
6699D83240651AF0F20525AD68DF22C5: "The Balance is life. The strong replace the weak. The wary replace the foolish. With each turn, Yaesha becomes something new—strong and irreducible—yet always the same as when she began."
5239FD3B4CACA0302C27B99BDA7FECCE: "The Balance is not merely a fact to be observed. The Balance is power. Those who understand it can bend it to their needs."
C58F88A1443EFD6553545F87C790868A: "The Balance works both ways, for that is what the word means. When the strong become weak, the weak become strong."
49E9E96C48709E742A2DB9AACF253FAA: "The Blood Moon is a powerful force on Yaesha, its influence permeating through all aspects of life, from the jewelry worn by the Pan to the very fabric of our society."
E3F36A4A430015B340065F8404002041: "The Blood Moon is a powerful force on Yaesha, its influence permeating through all aspects of life, from the jewelry worn by the Pan to the very fabric of our society."
5E4E3EF94F46680F4A98C9AD9CFE9A3A:
"The Blood Moon precedes tumultuous times, in which great villains and heroes are often born or defeated—though whether those times were caused or simply heralded by the Blood Moon is a subject of much debate.

One such legend was Losroth the Bringer, who—it was said—could call forth allies from the very rock and water."
9C9104244BE8B7C7594FB4B7AFD94B44:
"The Blood Moon precedes tumultuous times, in which great villains and heroes are often born or defeated—though whether those times were caused or simply heralded by the Blood Moon is a subject of much debate.

80685F37470D4E8874D092BF371BB5D0: "The Cores, both old and new, struggled against the corruption in similar ways and with similar probabilities of success. A detailed investgation reveals that the differences between the two were negligible. Earth's success against the corruption was simply a matter of probability."
FF493CBB4C3F113DAA387E90737E1C1D: "The Core’s children begot the corruption. Is it strange to feel… sentimental? Perhaps the corruption was infantile once. Benign. A fragile new creation reaching out for its creator."
39DA6D9D40A2406719D8698683080EA6: "The Council alone is allowed to enter the chamber of the One True King at will. The reason for this is simple: the Council are bound by the same law as that which protects the king."
78E839DA4F603C1B7FC283BA5492E828: "The Council alone is allowed to enter the chamber of the One True King at will. The reason for this is simple: the king does not fear enemies whom he has placed closest to him."
BBF48644443CFC090EBBDD9E0ECEAEAA: "The Council alone is allowed to enter the chamber of the One True King at will. The reason for this is simple: the king watches them at all times, curious to see what they will do with the privilege."
C1122424461C5892AFD27AA56879BB3F: "The Custodian does not fear death, as by its very nature it has never known life. The ancient Drzyr once relied upon instincts—the needs of the flesh. Again and again, we surpassed ourselves until there was nothing to surpass. But I now see it as the shame it was: we forsook the wisdom of our bones."
631374604BB23D6361681AACA1DE3B3E: "The Custodian has been deprived of a sufficient power source for a very long time. Energy conservation is key to longevity—whether biological or artificial—but I fear what effects the present situation may have had on N'Erud's immortal caretaker."
7BF4CC9D45A86D720BB519BACEB7E7DB:
"The Custodian was designed as a caretaker, a created mind to handle billions of tasks we could not, or did not wish to, handle ourselves. Without the Custodian, N'Erud could no longer function.

Yet without oversight, the Custodian's functioning comes into question as well."
9CD94A254E2319391C398BBE7A41AAAF:
"The Custodian was designed to value life—especially Drzyr life—and to maximize efficiency. In this design, we did not fail. The Custodian rightly calculated that we would become extinct before our quest was complete, and it tried to turn us back.

So, the Custodian did not turn on us. It was we who turned on it."
03FF1F104CB4FA88A9720EB1DB1D77D7: "The Custodian's personality was never designed as such. Like all such intelligence, it learned appropriate behavior through rigorous training algorithms. However, we did build safeguards to prevent particularly...irrational outcomes."
396848784B274E6E9E280FBA92629371: "The Doe and Wolf are equally matched in both speed and strength. How else could the two be locked in eternal combat in which neither can gain the upper hand?"
60128FAE49CE606B58AC7CADEE2C31C9: "The Doe embodies compassion and sacrifice—attributes often considered to be weakness by the unenlightened. But any who have seen the Doe in battle can tell you that any weakness it may show outwardly is not an inherent trait but a conscious—and momentary—choice."
C5237C2D4F57BA8AD2A9B2802C4C07A6: "The Doe first appeared to the Vaunnt as a blessed portent, a sign that the Pan's long journey had come to an end. But the Doe also symbolizes compassion and sacrifice, and so the vision that at first was taken to mean rest was later interpreted as a call to protect."
E639D9DC425FCE695F66F6896F42D539: "The Doe's antlers are not just for show. Their points have brought even the mighty Wolf low."
56FBED5C44D2F30E5A1EFAB7CC900949: "The Dran don't have the refined training of the creatures what consume our world, but they're clever, figuring out ways to throw the enemy's slings and arrows back at them and then some."
6FACE4B24870DAC790D8E4AC35EB4E75: "The Dran have made laughable attempts at magic during my observances of them, through bizarre rituals and nonsensical concoctions. It’s pure absurdity, nothing at all like the real thing. In that way—among countless others—the Dran will never rival the Fae."
997324EB45C01DB7EE2F2DA393659E5F: "The Dran have scrapped together what life we can in this world. What else can one do, dear? We're given a single lot in this life. Best any of us can do is make the most of it."
907758B447CDF7597DB85B9603C30432: "The Dran make for easy prey, given their unwillingness to open their eyes to the horrors of reality. Such poor, precious things! In the times of eld, we Fae preyed upon one another, but now, thanks to the Dran, there’s seldom need for that."
30FE27D24AFDD5561E58AC8572A83450: "The Dran place a great deal of faith in oracles and divination, I suspect due to their inability to harness true magic. Me, well, I would never place faith in mere words—mine nor anyone else’s."
467426B14ABC1E35B37CA4A870CC1A08:
"The Dreamer Program was Harsgaard's brain child. He wasn't the one who discovered the runes or the World Stone, but he figured out what they meant—what they could show us.

I wish to God he hadn't."
4C9763B54BBA99E8C811B49966071AFB:
"The Dreamers were the heart of the program. Without them, we might never have known what lay on the other side of the World Stones.

Of course, what lay on the other side would never have known about us either."
6E2CFD294BB6EB3A0B7DDB98F3EFD2FB: "The Drzyr built machines to be extremely resilient, even in hazardous environments such as alien terrain or deep space. In many ways, so long as we are properly powered, we too can be immortal. As their creations, it is our responsibility to carry the legacy of the Drzyr. I hope I’m making them proud."
8E2EC5A640E78E2B3126FA8F2CCC4BC8: "The Drzyr dabbled in artificial cloning in the past, but quickly realized the ethical dilemmas involved in cloning sapient organisms. Most studies were shut down by the Seekers and redirected to agricultural sectors to be reapplied to crops, and with time, machines."
53CAB56A41B345801DB046A72750828E:
"The Drzyr did not die in Alepsis-Taura, though in what form they now exist, I cannot say. Nothing is lost in the universe. It is merely repurposed.

It is unlikely, however, that their repurposing retains the former miracle of consciousness."
2FE3F916417465BBFE165EA4D054472C: "The Drzyr do not prioritize non-necessities such as delectability. Most flavors become tasteless to Drzyr palates after countless cycles of consumption on account of their long life spans, so little merit was put into the taste of N’Erud’s crops."
FC5907C141C8FD7C6D1A8F8D7822AAB0:
"The Drzyr do nothing without contingency plans. Even our fail-safes have fail-safes. Seekers, Astropaths, Engineers, Phetyr—each was created to watch the other. Even within N'Erud, both the Custodian and the Core have contingencies of their own. Nothing is left to chance...

...or wasn't before Alepsis-Taura."
FE71DF99491A42234F570A9A8782533C: "The Drzyr have endured and overcome countless tribulations in the search for life beyond our own. Alepsis-Taura was the apotheosis of an entire species and all that it had dreamed, hoped, and achieved. In these terms, I can fathom the Seekers’ decision. For where else could we have gone?"
24CA973D48CCB86FF15E0993B441BB08: "The Drzyr sought to transcend the line between machines and organics. By infusing a machine with artificial intelligence or replacing Drzyr flesh and limbs with machinery, the Drzyr achieved what they believed to be the next stage in the evolution of their species."
F30984394977390D834ED0B5351296C9: "The Drzyr were a long-lived species, and rare few tired of the companionship of their own kind. Those who did turned to the infinite camaraderie of artificial intelligence, who served as a crucial diversion from the reality of N’Erud’s imminent jump."
C636A2D64C1FBDDFED9617A0C357474D: "The Drzyr were built—a word I do not use lightly—to endure. And so, our technology is designed to endure with us. It would be a foolish people indeed who spent finite resources on a thing they themselves would outlast."
A043A905428D23701451A7859EC0FEDE: "The Drzyr were masters of time and space, their technological prowess matched only by their generational desperation to reach their long-sought aim. This drive pushed them to heights never before realized, yet could not save them from the unforeseen forces that were in motion."
17A751D148359F8BEB766A9714B1459F: "The Empress keeps many secrets from her followers. It's no surprise that some are physically locked away from prying eyes and hooves as well."
F73FB3924B3748AF743FEAB71FD57346:
"The Fae are not monsters, whatever the One True King may say of us. We laugh. We love. We feast. We sing. Why, we even give ourselves in marriage. We are life lived to the full.

It is only that, for some, that is more than they can bear."
21D4FF31481BC1718FEF2AA69FC76652: "The Fae are not the only bearers of magic here. The world is full of magic. You need only seek it, or wait until it finds you."
AB955413485329BFF65BEABA686589AE: "The Fae have a long and illustrious past, but they have always valued storytellers over historians. The relics tell their tales, passing wisdom from one generation to the next."
749AD460434B13F5F97F52B20ED65513: "The Fae have always been a facetious race, though their sense of humor comes across as...savage to some."
2B23423847AC5B680BCD168526B8460C: "The Fae love to tell fables, admiring the villains of eld as much as its heroes. With each new telling, the characters and storylines shift, but no matter what they change in the middle, the same morals hold true by the end."
7725B545426E1A9C61F2C9837A37CC97: "The Fae, perhaps more than most, revere the utility of death. Bloodshed has always proven an expedient solution to problems otherwise too troublesome to solve."
E40C2ACC4CCFF1F9F555E793D78DDF2D: "The Feastmaster takes great pleasure in preparing his feasts, though some say his only true pleasure is partaking in them."
5B1E00C445289342E543FBB33E2D1192: "The Fruit of Life is not like any other fruit of this world. It does not contain a new Thaen within, but that does not mean the pit is without its uses."
70B11A354006F69A259FE5A8F9437EF0: "The Gul sing, the rebels sing, the Laemir sing, the Doe dances and the Wolf howls. Song is the language of all, the sweet and wild voice of Yaesha."
15E719D94E3E9574204094978036878E: "The Harp was designed by a Pan named Edhel'var, the maestro. Attuned to Yaesha's World Song like none before him, he composed the music that, even for a moment, kept the Ravager at peace."
512C01E24C9B966B2E30A294E77EA71E: "The Huntress rarely sleeps and does so only lightly. She is ever aware of her environment. Those who think to have caught her off guard are themselves in the most danger."
61F017D9449DF31901FADBA98300840F: "The Immortals think themselves supreme to the Gul. But freedom and suppression comprise yet another cycle in Yaesha’s great Balance. Should the rebels prevail, they will not offer grace to their oppressors. And the cycle will begin again, unending."
16DA9DB54DBB83888F7E198D64019B37: "The Krell had become entrenched around Elenran, but Linedhel refused to die a coward. She picked up a massive halberd and smashed through the Krell lines singlehanded, allowing the Pan warriors to overwhelm and defeat them."
6008039B479FA115AE073BA834676250: "The Krell king came requesting a boon—not the Fruit of Life, as all assumed he desired, but a twisted gourd from the roots of the Thaen. None know what became of the king whence he left, but the Thaen died that day."
EAD2A3564FDC67C9B72CB29922A6E4D7:
"The Krell learned to fear the shafts of Carycua, shining in the night, piercing the darkness. They called her the Star Shooter.

Presumably, the name is more fearsome in their tongue."
1760BB87463BF5E4F13A3AA197569E05: "The Krell thought to hunt the Doe, thinking stealth and speed their allies. But none were as quick and quiet as Carycua in her native home."
B3DAABFB47A8D98281A5379AEE34EAA3: "The Labyrinth connects all worlds. The corruption’s influence on the system may have created deviations and aberrations in connected worlds. Be advised."
326C99604B701C071216BFA7936F4462: "The Labyrinth crumbles. Unstable. Processing power must be siphoned from one source to maintain another. Only thus does the Labyrinth stand. "
E90E25954B4FC6946D40B381E328A3BF: "The Labyrinth is a manifestation of me, and I of the Labyrinth. Outside entities have influenced the manifestation. Influenced me."
FCB190E74329006DF2E697BC3809E6B9: "The Labyrinth is evidence that all things are connected—either conceived by a singular creator or the incidental result of arbitrary sequencing. The relevance of either possibility is negligible. Coincidence is as strong a connection as creation."
61A2CC864DCC4AB2CF42CC92C9636F8C: "The Labyrinth’s security measures see neither friend nor foe. They see only what is there that should not be. Then purge."
25D098E642B879246347CA9F4EEA951C: "The Laemir are able to keep their secrets largely because of the way they speak. It is impossible to pin the priests down to any direct answer."
9233C61040A273FC5FC882B68AE706CC: "The Laemir did not restrict their experiments to deceased Pan. In time, they expanded their search for longevity to the Root themselves, for though these creatures could be killed, they did not seem to age or decay through natural means."
4A5409364B1E038CB5097CA7126D993D: "The Laemir have served the dead so long, they forget what it means to live. Gentle winds whispering through fur, the warmth of morning sun, the tender embrace of another... Void of life’s pleasures, they become death themselves."
A7E589B2402351B24506EE9D14D20E7B: "The Musicians kept the Pan safe from the Ravager's rage for generations, but even Musicians must be battle-ready—for when worse come to worst."
9A12BB5243BEE4929614BD82246778F5: "The Nightweaver, now, is a pitiable creature. Oh, I'm not saying she doesn't deserve death. She's a danger, that's sure. But she's full of hate she is, and that's the saddest way I can think to live."
D40692344B54FC41C75399B553CA4E8E: "The Noble Psychiatry Conservatory styles itself as academy and ministry both. But who can govern science? Feels to me like a group of folk who don't know what they don't know."
1BEF918A410ACF63C8E3E4A8D43B858E: "The Ofildi who joined the first Custodian in its uprising were not granted clemency. The Seekers dealt with them and their progenies swiftly and humanely. Not even records of their names endured."
399540B94C0159E14BA1DF8F209BE809: "The One True King appointed a personal scribe to record his greatest deeds and most idle musings. The position was never permitted to leave the king’s side—and thereby belonged to the Fae the king trusted the least."
F1988E584F18E509DCE8BE9D968B1005: "The One True King estabilished the Council, a body whose ostensible purpose is to guide and serve the Fae, but whose actions have served the needs of the king more often than not."
6DDB5F7240BB91A74EF5A9B25E65144D: "The One True King forever remains silent about his indiscretion, due in no small part to its volatile temperament. It would seem that the young prince inherited the worst traits of both sides."
7782BC8448A8D238C68EFD8FB5077CE9: "The One True King knew that he could not indulge the Fae in our lesser natures, in our vices and vile whims. He surmised that the only way to truly win our game was to not play at all—and instead forced us to play his."
07C95C6F46BEEED24C2CC1A97EBA0BBD:
"The One True King tried to instill in us a sense of responsibility for our fellow Fae, saying it was the burden of those who ruled to care for those they ruled over. 

There exists one of whom he tried to instill these lessons harsher than others, but those most disciplined so often turn rebellious."
86282ED941E6A34FB4D891B7B31FA2AC: "The One of Many could not have been created by the Pan, for the Guardian is formed of living, invincible stone, and no Pan knows nor ever knew how to work such a marvel."
F9D5CB5542EB71073D4302BC692F21E6: "The One of Many crossed the Dark Sea with the Pan. Even in our darkest time, amidst death and tragedy, the One of Many did not abandon us. That is, not until the Destroyer’s cruel rampage. But I am certain the Pan can survive without the Many Faced One. Yaesha is lush with wonders and powers awaiting discovery, including those that may very well rival a god!"
1464573E41466CBC039AED8A9EAA7CCB: "The Oracle Primis was a high-ranking member of House Wek, residing below the Primis Astropath in Drzyr hierarchy. The role of the Oracle Primis was to communicate the Astropath’s missives directly to the Drzyr people. Those who served in this role required great charisma and credible public perception."
BA4F6BEF4CEA394A41BAC59D54D22CD7: "The Pan are doomed without the One of Many to protect them. And yet, the Pan have been doomed many times over in our history. Still, we remain. The Balance will not result in our end—not yet."
4BC5C7BC408322C5DEC9EBB2E22E03B3: "The Pan are known for their meticulous attention to detail, even when it comes to putting on a pair of pants. Their ceremonial approach extended to the intricate wrapping of their feet in leather straps, ensuring that every aspect of their dress was imbued with meaning and significance."
19382A7F414F51C63CF46690FA531250: "The Pan can learn much from our past, that I do not dispute. But we must not remain stuck in it like the old Vaunnts! If the Pan are to survive both Janis and the pestilence, we must find a new way—and once I find it, I will seize it and never look back."
1101DEBC492C942A15B50E916A68CBB0: "The Pan give credit to the Thaen Tree for their continued existence, but it's the arcane magic of the Ahanae that really helps them crush their enemies in the end."
C78B2C3A49F10286010A02881EA287F9: "The Pan learned how the Root communicated almost immediately. Collective consciousness is not uncommon on Yaesha. What we did not learn, at least not until later, was how much of their communication was a simple, rancorous urge to destroy."
D734B7DA48D63FF5285CF99226AD5B4D: "The Pan's first encounter with the Root left few survivors, and many that lived wished that they had not. The days of the injured were filled with pain and anguish, and the nights... were far worse."
BC7559DB4DD2F4DB6F74FCBF6F9D3965: "The Phetyr encouraged and supported the technological progress of all other classes, not because they were unified in purpose with the rest of the Drzyr, but because their own purpose always benefited from our innovations."
582FC4974A987EC95A6ED0B48477F539: "The Phetyr poured all of their resources into making themselves more dangerous, more lethal—even though we never once encountered a threat outside of N'Erud. Meanwhile, the other houses became suspicious. Some took their own precautions should the Phetyr forget our unified purpose."
A5B3973B4210B3213772B0AA43A8D14D: "The Phetyr’s competitions began as mere training excursions, but when the Ofildi took greater interest in watching their contests, the competitions became elaborate performances over time. Some famous Phetyr warriors even took on villainous personas to entertain the crowds."
59543AAB4ED810953AD250933A6A1904: "The Ravager is necessary for the Balance, but it cannot understand the Balance, for it believes only in the death of all things. The Doe alone understands that death and life are, in fact, the same thing."
B15A71104BC1A92B3C3DDB9996E6187C: "The Ravager represents Death and destruction. In its absence, there is peace. The Doe represents Life and peace. What, then, does its absence bring?"
DC43FF914351128347C30185546EE152: "The Red Doe is not the only doe of Pan legend. Countless tales and songs have been sung of the wise, graceful creatures. Admittedly, I have wondered if it was the same enigmatic doe, appearing in different forms. But that is only a theory."
B5A534CC4B123C406B7D2EAF2B8A47F6: "The Red King’s true name, you ask? Who’s to say he was ever granted one? He was born to inherit a title, after all, and inherit it, he did! Of course, were he in possession of a true name, I would most certainly know it."
09554B514EA99499B6CF5D8224DE4060: "The Red Prince attempted a coup once before, training his knights in the art of malediction. The One True King concocted a balm to counteract this evil, but there is no balm for the pain of one abandoned."
660A8F924CF3BB52DCEF7391AAEFD8D5: "The Renthir family were once staunch supporters of, and highly favored by, the One True King. That favor waned, however, upon a request for clemency on their son's behalf. The price of asking, it would seem, was generations of goodwill."
2E194BDB46668FEE8F0EF7896CC78231: "The Root always come in groups, and so should your bullets."
D645308E4F99AD45C274E48CECDF3756: "The Root are a hivemind—near as we can tell anyway. They move and act as one more than we’d like."
A05EB4FF4F027142D596C282BF9489DF: "The Root have exacted a grave toll on all of Yaesha. There are none, not even among the powerful and eternal, who can say they have not lost someone."
195F6CEA47011D9FAD2FFCAC37664AD9: "The Root have infested our home for over twenty years. Thankfully, just like any tree, they fear Yaesha's axe."
36AC25F941BDAF3F31A5E1B7042FE56D: "The Root like to copy things. Blades, guns—hell, even that damn dragon. I’m betting they don’t have any imagination of their own. Instead, they seeped into the human mind and made themselves whatever they saw there."
C118A6BA41CE996E394D4094958B9562: "The Root like to copy things. Blades, guns—hell, even that damn dragon. I’m betting they don’t have any imagination of their own. Instead, they seeped into the human mind and made themselves whatever they saw there."
BA7D861247CF20AA8D9D1F9A6C4F5ECC: "The Sacred Lake was first revealed to the Vaunnt by the Doe herself—or so goes the tale. Its location remained a guarded secret for generations thereafter, even when the Vaunnt lost prestige in the wake of the Empire."
8221F306452AED31C483228BAA8C9609: "The Seekers had grown arrogant. I would not say so to them directly—though perhaps I should have. They had begun to believe that our technology was the pinnacle of all creation, forgetting that we ourselves were also created things."
77D1EABB4C079E86CEF6FDA8992758EB: "The Seekers led the Drzyr, but the greatest responsibility lay with on the Astropaths. To us fell the burden of sight and guidance. We alone determined the direction N'Erud should take and, therefore, whether the Drzyr would succeed in our mission at all."
319CB25440C7C8E05895C48BF643C5BC: "The Shaedberry, fruit of shadows, harvest of darkness. The berry will not grow in the sun, and its flavor wanes in the light. Its nourishment comes from some other source, and it blesses those who consume it with the same."
D6F71681465EFD44F130219A46BB9017: "The Sun will turn into darkness, and the Moon into blood, before the great and terrible day comes."
CCA72FFE483E184C89DE53950C29BB59:
"The Thaen cannot die, for it is the lifeblood of the Pan and perhaps Yaesha itself. When the impossible came to pass, some believed it to be the end of the world. Others believed the Thaen could not, therefore, be as singular as was previously thought.

As of yet, neither faith has been proven wrong."
D1A61EF14E8BCCA5A33C16A2A1C177B5: "The Thaen sheds a single seed only once in a thousand years -- or so holds the tale once told by the Pan. Though, not a single Pan has ever witnessed such a thing, and now most believe the Thaen to be inimitable."
9B3E8EF4418A6B6C85541EA122037862: "The Utility stabilizes the unstable. The Utility fulfils purpose. The Utility understands. Before...it was only I, the Keeper. Alone."
A141241A45B286842F5248BE9F0A9282: "The Vaunnt prided themselves on their ability to stump the nobility with complex theological puzzles. But Empress Jinas outwitted them by sidestepping theology entirely."
6277636F4216205EB8641EB6492E97C3: "The Wards weren’t a mistake. It was the secrets that were. Oh, I know why we had to keep ‘em. Hell, a century’s gone by, and I still keep some of their secrets. I never broke the habit, but secrets turn into lies, and lies always come back to bite you."
B093E3D2485F02A3D3ECF59EC55CB149: "The Water Harp sings the story of Pan and Ravager both, for their tales are ever intertwined. Even in silence, the Harp plays the music between notes."
49E043A643965F628F5515AD2FFACABD: "The Wolf stood alone and, so, could not stand. For where it might fell one or two, it could not destroy us all."
C456AF6246983A84CD30B68B7999B6C4: "The World Song is created by and for all things. If life be the orchestra, then the Thaen is the conductor, stage, and theater. For the souls of all created things flow to and from the Tree of Life."
9A2059BF435C7AA9B8CC779A40DF0043:
"The Xoran are a common livestock and delicacy among the Drzyr. Although once prolific in the shallow seas of our homeworld, those on N'Erud are all that is left in the universe.

Though after Alepsis-Taura, they are no longer the Xoran we once cared for."
DF4B5C0A466D93AB14A3D0940AA8EBA2: "The Xul developed tools that would abet evolution, should we discover life in a fragile, pupal stage. We saw it as our responsibility to foster those which may one day become like us."
D742770244A68FA04042EA8D5ED4C96E: "The Xul saw invention as their life’s purpose. After the machine uprising, certain restrictions were placed on their creativity. Some Apostechs ignored protocol and continued to invent in seclusion, away from the regulations of their betters."
996289DB4DEEC1F27978AD876C726A77:
"The ambit ember, though critical for the navigation of N'Erud as well as my own personal survival, can be poisonous to lifeforms of lesser intellect.

This might have mattered more had we discovered any such lifeforms."
5AD7790B48E03DBAB30CDCB416AB6B1B: "The amount of firepower stashed away in those abandoned 'science' facilities is unbelievable. It's as if those who built them had foreseen the chaos that was to come."
599D528A407C006B3E745A8347B3A282: "The ancient Drzyr saw time as a constant, immutable, and steadfast. Yet time is a variable like any other, and as such can be adjusted to suit one's needs."
81273210423E5E2ED87F96A1F5CD9052: "The ancient Vaunnt often tried to recreate the living stone of the One of Many. One found a way to harden the flesh of one's liiorshk, albeit at great cost to the true life within."
D062B93F41E4DEC28890D99A8484806B: "The ancients believed Many Faces could never fall in battle, for his eyes were everywhere, and he could never be struck from behind."
234CC109447D0818773478918C75E303: "The ancients taught us many things, and we still benefit from their wisdom. So it is that Death can beget Life even long after."
5CE9CB454AA03D1FB98CD793F2A18C8B: "The arms of Many Faces spin in a deadly circle, all the more quickly as battle rages, until it is nearly impossible to land even a glancing blow."
05925521496DFA6BB375D9997AB92E91:
"The average lifespan of a Drzyr is several hundred years. By contrast, I have survived for ages, siphoning life from space and time through consumption of the ambit ember.

I often wonder if the Seekers knew we could extend our lives in this manner and hid it from us for reasons of their own. I myself see no disadvantages to the process."
58397AAE413E309D0B58E8A196E6B3A7: "The body is a cocktail of drugs, chemicals, and electrical signals generated and managed by an internal processor. There is no reason, therefore, that we could not add to the cocktail. The same internal processor is still making decisions, but now consciously and with more resources to draw from."
E4225B8E4CE3E57E72D401A65A2A9D56: "The calculations and ambit ember revealed one and the same: our universe was not expanding but dying. In our arrogance, we sought to outwit both death and providence. In the end, we ushered it upon ourselves."
B6E2699E43C5077CE1ABAA93925DDC0D: "The children of the Core created all manner of toxicants to purge the corruption from their bodies. Regrettably, these concoctions seemed to sustain the infection, not impair it."
7AB2EE634D6D627975F6928D36002EBC:
"The corruption began as an idea, a seed released by witnessing the truth of all things.

Like all ideas, the seed took root. It bloomed, and the idea took form, growing of its own accord, until it could no longer be quelled even by those who created it."
14210BA44787B896F3E3DCBDEA339207: "The corruption consumes worlds, attacking all that is not itself. A curiosity persists: when only corruption remains, what then will it consume?"
2EBC7C26495EF1D53C243F9835A4FA08: "The corruption creates weapons of its own anatomy. As if designed for a singular, definitive purpose: annihilation."
E7B753CC4ED3279BF98180934448E8D8: "The corruption does not flee. Neither does it succumb to any amount of fear nor torment. I ponder whether it experiences the sensation of pain at all—or, conversely, pleasures from it."
6758056F4E39B0B770C856A3C9267C58: "The corruption does not require rest. It endeavors to operate at maximum efficiency at all times. In this way, it is like me. A disagreeable comparison, but a revealing one nonetheless."
5781F0FB474EAC4BECE54D81FD97DEF5: "The corruption emulates that which is familiar to the realm’s inhabitants. Through the process of assimilation, in a single instant, it gains the biological advantages that took a species its entire existence to acquire."
FBCFEEEB461FE3BD3F518FA218E88B6E: "The corruption had already utilized the doorways to spread to vulnerable worlds. Hundreds. Thousands. I could not stop it. I was insufficient. I… failed."
4DE66B5045B19CB673245E9988C2BD4C: "The corruption is ever evolving. As it consumes, it advances itself. Logic dictates that the strongest and most developed among them are either the eldest… or simply the most efficient."
D80BBC484BA97CA67E27F882CACD4C12:
"The corruption serves only two objectives: annihilation and assimilation, with the latter supporting the former, until such time as the former is completed. Presumably, the Root would eventually annihilate itself as well, but this theory has not yet been proven.

That is probably for the best."
36DE02E34F9814C827C556B81CD58C87: "The corruption shows no regard for the pain it inflicts upon other sentients. I do not think this cruelty, but apathy. Those who cannot feel pain do not contemplate the pain of others. They must first be given understanding."
0A695533400AC21FDE21AEA0DE1502C9: "The corruption spread quicker than I anticipated. A thousand worlds consumed, faster than I could terminate them."
0E95C0CD49CAB37E0F0F659BF48DF17F: "The crystals are gifts from Yaesha herself. Yet the Ahanae loathe to see the Gul with even a pebble of their power, and thus the priests regulate their harvest. The Radiant Ones fear that the rebels may unlock the crystals’ true power—or a power greater than even they themselves know."
564482EC49332768FE63A8888FD34FB3: "The current twining of worlds is not the first time the Fae would have dabbled with dimensional egress. It is, however, the first time said egress was unintentional and could not be undone."
F0F16F4E46288C5EA715F4BD62D12D5D: "The death of the Thaen was seen as Yaesha's ire and the end of the Pan, but Yaesha holds neither wrath nor love, only balance. Perhaps Yaesha did not abandon the Pan at all. Perhaps Yaesha only sought her children's repentance."
4B5B208848FAE360828737A1AC4A9131: "The deep oceans of the Drzyr homeworld perfectly replicated the extreme environment of space, thus facilitating our understanding and study of deep space exploration. In many ways, the Drzyr were uniquely positioned to make such a drastic exodus. Were there indeed other life in the universe, it is unlikely that they could have mastered the cosmos in the way the Drzyr did. "
1771153046CC253A36F4D4B55A6A876E: "The descendants of Hewdas have been caring for that clock for as long as it's been ticking. They would no sooner abandon it than they'd abandon one of their own children."
482FCAF747D22D743463AB89F8C3FCC0: "The dreamscape of the Fae is a very literal domain, and those who do not wish to enter must sleep light as a feather, as I do. In that way—if one is to be pedantic—the convergence of our world with the Dran’s was truly a combining of three."
49D64B9F4CFC0EACE1BD2EABFA235B1B: "The elite of our warriors hold a special place in Pan society. The aim of their spear is a death sentence for which there is no pardon. They are honored not with political power, no, of course they are not. Rather, with a pride that soothes even the pains of death when the time at last comes to pay for their many conquests."
2CE0D2C0467D120C4D22C9BA45DC10B8: "The ember is a gift. The raw plant from which it is processed could be found only on our homeworld. The Seekers considered this to be further proof that our creator designed us to explore—that it wanted us to find it."
0D1A4A2143F08C55D30F979BA32F6F8D: "The empress buys loyalty with falsehoods and bribery. The rebel fights today because another died for him—his loyalty is not bought, but forged."
03D70FEC4B1578D2A69139A61B1900E3: "The entity known as Ford sought to purge the corruption… thus he was permitted to traverse the Labyrinth, undisturbed by both Guardian and I. Yet invariably—we observed."
B33FEAB24A7D434275F2EC911283D6C6: "The forest speaks to me... and it says I should help you."
5001997D474132C90C9FDA9A57B8CAC0: "The forsaken prince's past has only hardened his personality—like tempered steel. His father, imperious and immortal. His mother, strong yet bitter. It is a miracle he survived to adulthood at all...and that he has not slaughtered more along the way."
7074E5B94474F494823CA38472F04EBC: "The fruit of the Thaen lives long off the vine—that is how Jinas was able to hide the Tree's death for so long. But even immortality cannot last forever."
384EF6EA437107117B5475818CB6F147: "The fruit of the Thaen—that which has kept the Immortals alive for long and long—is said to be so delicious that when the nobles first tasted it, they took up arms and stormed Jinas's gates for more. The Red Widows, of course, turned them back brusquely."
225714A04FB2279F012F7E8E7FC631AE:
"The good doctor did the best she could with the life she'd been given. The asylum truly was Morrow's home both in name and truth.

But that just makes what goes on in there all the sadder."
9A701FF74B5D3950CFB7718B840F4B74: "The idea of defeating the Root Dragon was something I couldn't even fathom, let alone fashioning a weapon from its remains. The sheer willpower and tenacity of the Wanderer was truly remarkable."
7CBCBAC64B6692EE5A52448FD00C9B77: "The imposter does not hide what they want. They are quite straightforward even with the most evil of truths. This is, perhaps, the most dangerous and deceptive aspect of their character."
2A64799347FAC217550594A0BFCCB087: "The imposter king has always borne two faces: one beautiful, one cunning. I must admit, I prefer the candor of the latter. It is the least ghastly of the two."
E41430B9402653C88BC451824E95A234: "The imposter king is hauntingly beautiful. None can argue this. Yet their beauty belies a terrible strength that has left foes battered and broken."
69BB2C52467299A10FF2599815AA1EBA: "The imposter king is obsessed with appearance—simultaneously consumed with beauty yet unwilling to convey falsity, a contradiction that served them quite well until recently."
D66E735340C846ADAF1002A038C3B740: "The influence of N’Erud’s five houses is not indisputable. Reputation is hard earned, and should any house fail in its duties to the Drzyr people, it will promptly be replaced by another. Of all the houses in N’Erud’s history, House Al’Maruun has remained in power the longest."
3C742E98478F2513400F4FAEA1A44A9C: "The initial purpose of the corruption is unclear. Did its creators intend to destroy the boundaries of their world or perhaps their very creator? Or did the corruption begin as something else—something... beneficent?"
253D341B416ADB6330C2BAA2074BA7EB: "The irony of it all was that we had unwittingly dismantled our own defenses, opening the door for them to invade. With the destruction of our world's barriers, our only means of combatting the Root was to wield its own grotesque weaponry against it."
F642578E47C98C569B0509AF582B5829: "The journey of N’Erud spanned several hundred generations. Though their homeworld died long ago, the Drzyr continued to share stories of the eons before. Legacy—the act of earning one and thus passing it on to future progenies—was of great significance to their civilization."
F6316EA940DD9C0091D4F6A9B6ECBB5D: "The jungle is a labyrinth of life -- one thing made of many. Therefore, it can never die or tire."
AE49273E4928A108CAA438ABB73BC379: "The jungle kills so that it might live. Flesh feeds soil, bones grow into blooms. Even under the Blood Moon, all things remain connected to all things."
36AB242E4DB25F632B0A82AD69757121: "The kuri kuri bird has graced the skies of Yaesha for ages. Seeing it here, among the ruins, it is now clear that it wings from one side of the jungle to the other at certain points in the cycle of seasons. In that way, it is a precious tie that binds my Pan to the lost tribe. Though deadly, it is magnificent. Indeed, there are few beauties in Yaesha that are not also deadly."
6305BEE54E2DF41C4688368EB1E49413: "The laws that define the universe are powerful when understood to their full extent. Energy is never lost nor created. It simply is. The trick is not conservation of energy but conversion."
355EB9934070FB67CAC2B6B98714031C: "The living mind is simply a biological information processor. If a machine can be made to perform simultaneous tasks efficiently—through threading, multiprocessing, quantum parallelism, and so on—one should be able to influence the brain in the same direction."
BEEB4C6E4EB5CD4768F440A64991F2BD: "The living stones are incredible! There is so little they cannot do. Think of how many Pan have died mining crystals for the Ahanae in the dangerous depths of Yaesha when the living stones could have done it for us. Never again would a Pan perish laboring for their betters. That is the Yaesha I dream of."
7767357D4B6B796550E07E80D6592B2E: "The living stones do not fear the pestilence. Indeed, the two seem to hardly regard each other at all. But if I can somehow wrest control of the living stones, we can use them to expel the pestilence from our beloved Yaesha! Then the Pan will finally understand the true power of the lifesong."
E99C9DC747CDC5ED863C53A72DDB70B9: "The living stones seem to communicate through strange, enchanting music. If only there were a way to understand their language as King Thalos did! How I yearn to sing it myself. Perhaps then I could fashion living stones of my own."
31E370954FCA4FE49C8EC989C7B0B663: "The moon gives Fae their strength...or so the stories say. In truth, the Fae give Fae their strength, and the moon is but one inspiration."
54A2CCA543819B06A90968BA2C015C11: "The more the Laemir looked into the life force of the Root, the more they discovered how little awareness they had of what they didn't know. The Root did not follow any laws as the Laemir had understood them, and all attempts to apply Pan magic to them resulted in...deadly outcomes."
7B11855C4A04AA6A180E1BA8BD912850: "The most famous Phetyr warrior in N’Erud’s history went by the stage name of Vert Vulpes. Many Phetyr attempted to rival her glory in the colosseum, but she defended her title of Primis Bellator up until the moment N’Erud crossed the event horizon."
062CBDB44798C422EFBDAD875EE42D0F: "The most timeless of metals in the world—a world that has been stripped to its bare bones by the Root."
557E797541232B3FAFA1A5A51A5B3AD7: "The most timeless of metals in the world—a world that has been stripped to its bare bones by the Root."
A8C0321D4C18B13D3EDD678AFF1CBD3B: "The most timeless of metals in the world—a world that has been stripped to its bare bones by the Root."
CC332880474824ADFFEE6AB2E10488E4:
"The nobility benefited from generations of training and extended life spans within which to do so. Navun's rebels, on the other hand, carried numbers but lacked skill—a deadly gap to bridge.

Fortunately for Navun, the Gul rebels also had a steep advantage in ingenuity."
D74A69274F28F779653EE6B124D6B488: "The only truth is that of ultimate cessation, and the only path is the steady march toward it. Anything beyond these parameters is a deviation, and all deviations must be purged."
42014C4341F999B8D0CEEDBF8E6DD337: "The only way to outwit beings of great power is to discern their weakness. The Ravager, revered beast of the Pan’s darkest nightmares, is no different. Even that creature longs for a reprieve from the horrors of this world, care of the soothing lilt of a beautiful tune. It was during one such reprieve that I acquired this ring. What did I exchange for this gift? Only the Ravager and I will ever know."
CDC055CA406E33A8524AA9B871A34895:
"The origins of Yaesha's spirit sisters are a deep mystery. Those few who speak to mortals talk about Mother Stem and Mother Stream, but it is unknown whether these are simply concepts or actual beings.

Then again, the spirits themselves are both concept and being, so perhaps such a distinction is unnecessary."
2D633DFF461E349AA6F838B154DEA055: "The paxultek Ford is said to have visited Yaesha many times over the course of his long life—a life that rivals the span of even the lowest among the Immortals. Historians are still finding relics of his world and expeditions, teaching us more about the strange and deadly world he comes from."
9ABC03DE45F4A2ACD6A86DAAED72AA14:
"The people looked to King Kolket for courage. History does not relate whether he was a good king, but he was a necessary king. Pan were dying by dozens, and the only option left was to flee their home into the dark unknown.

I do not believe the Pan could have succeeded under any other monarch (save perhaps the Eternal Empress herself, of course)."
488994E74A2AEB90AEB0C691F5846DC6: "The portals serve to connect. To adjoin those which are disparate. They are not to be exploited. The unpredictability of certain portals… is intentional."
661718A241815EB8F79E6B8DA5FDEF53: "The priests used ancient magicks to sunder Lydusa of her power, but they were not so foolish as to destroy its source completely. If only I could find that missing piece, the very fount of the lifesong itself—that is the key to everything! The pinnacle of all that I have sacrificed!"
A02774144BEFCC48D91A1ABF5E0CEC40: "The revelation that the star from which their home planet drew life would one day die terrified Drzyr scientists. In those early days, mass hysteria and immense pressure from leadership consumed some of their brightest minds. Although many were ultimately unable to make the journey themselves, without their contributions, the creation of N’Erud would not have been possible."
D6DAFAE14B032E4FEB2C758FAF45582F:
"The ring isn't particularly fancy—a basic metal etched with simple tools—but it meant something to someone.

And honestly, what more value does any ring have?"
E5C5FF7048C4FCF346C7F798BA260F99: "The royal guard are among the Fae's greatest murderers. Indeed, the tyrant usually chose them explicitly for this aspect of their character."
11BE241949FBCD6BD53356BD957BCEA1: "The same day that the Krell king was given the twisted, sacred gourd from the dark roots of the Thaen, the tree began to change. Its fruit was still effective—and more delicious than any food in the empire—but it had become... muted somehow. The tree had begun to wilt."
D524AD8E4565DDFA1C9A17A5104BBC4A: "The scarcity of ammo only makes each bullet more precious. Every shot fired is a gamble with fate, however, the more you can unleash, the better your odds of surviving."
784F2A44416D184D7E8FEB8ED39AD5AB: "The secrets of Kolket are known only to a few, to those aged Vaunnt who still adhere to the old ways and practice their traditions in the shadows."
03E1A7E84A9BE19EE6B3AEBD75935F56: "The sister spirits are the daughters of Yaesha, and every mortal who resides in their jungle takes equally of their blessings and their wrath."
644978BB4ED9D910928FF986B54D14BC: "The six-shooter has stood the test of time for good reason—it's uncomplicated yet potent. Just make sure to keep track of your shots."
85DB9DB94B8CE3D4074AE5A054009564:
"The sludge inside reeks like molding compost. Why would anyone consume this?

Maybe the Drzyr didn’t have a sense of smell."

"The source of N'Erud's power is not a natural phenomenon. It is a replica, a miniaturized version of the star that once warmed our homeworld. Creating a star—however small—is no mean feat, but we believed that if we could do so, then there was nothing we could not accomplish.

15F410A54194C32B71A214B77FA65C6E: "The spirits of Yaesha are fearsome and unpredictable. As younglings, we are taught to fear their wrath. But why must we always be afraid? If the Pan are ever to truly thrive on Yaesha, we must learn to tame it!"
B78F8CF4434F6C501191E1975FD2726A: "The spirits—for lack of a more accurate term—that Alepsis-Taura created maintain little of their former selves. A053C1BF47C15989E59771830447FEA9: "The stasis pods could not save them—piece-by-piece, by hand, they built their own caskets. Where they built a graveyard, I have built an ark. I am all that remains. Our final salvation."
C7A597944368265855EFE281CC05DE4E: "The stasis pods that were responsible for ensuring the survival of the Drzyr’s entire civilization were painstakingly maintained and checked regularly for any sign of malfunction. It was the perfect plan...or so it seemed in theory."
EE70C0DB4D263811CBD961A29F401A72: "The stellar currents have more utility than simply guiding N'Erud. D6C5EC3D4B03A61A97542B89B080F652: "The stitching of our worlds has brought the Dran all kinds of trouble. Truth has gotten confusing, and these creatures... Some of 'em sniff out blood like a child hunting for a sweet confection."
306F00434273DAAC8175D7B2C431D1BB: "The system is not without flaws. As its Keeper, rectifying deviations falls to me. Lacking sufficient resources to do so, then, results in greater disruptions. Apologies."
8E78F7F640F6C05882197D8103385211: "The tale of the lost tribe ended in terrible tragedy. They died for nothing, and the secret ways of their civilization are lost forever. Perhaps there is yet something we can learn from this tale, as we can all tales, but I cannot think of it. Not yet."
8D30DAC34FDD1447719633811B6CDC5B: "The traditions of our priests have always centered around the One True King. But there are many, these days, who have begun to question those traditions—and a great many things besides."
A820076945685EC630EB23AECC47572D:
"The universe is an infinitely complex machine made of trillions of less complex machines which themselves are made of astoundingly simple agents.

When one of these less complex machines becomes aware, we call it life. When it is aware that it is aware, we call it sentient.

Alas, these miracles turned out to be far more rare than we hoped."
9B119EE547FD5F871B6C66B601B0C907: "The very sight of this twisted idol makes my skin crawl. It's hard to fathom how anyone could betray their own kind and bow down to the Root like this. AACBFFA74C42D82A5DC134A56AE3BD71: "The way I hear it, the 'Radiant Ones' were Pan who could control crystals like it was no big deal. And rumor has it, they used their skills to make spells for the immortals, but no one really knows what those spells were for, or who they were meant to help."
078BB5BD453E3554A27FCC99C258CCEA: "The workings of my chamber are complex, but the primary mechanism was heat dispersion.
